svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four slide blocks, 60 x 60 x 20 mm (20 mm thick = the side plate),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bored 40 mm in the middle for a flanged bronze bush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit in the 60 mm slots with 0.2 mm clearance; break the edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six flanged bronze bushes 30 x 40 x 20 mm, 52 mm flange 6 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thick, pressed in from the outside; a grease hole in each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 3 mm keeper plate on the inside face holds each block in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pinch screws M16 x 120 (two) with 90 mm handwheels. Bending

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws M20 x 1.5 fine pitch, 150 mm (two), with 110 mm handwheels.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each screw has a collar captured in the top of its block.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bending roll adjuster on each bending screw: an M20 x 1.5 lock nut

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the bridge; an 80 mm dial of 60 divisions (0.025 mm each),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clamped to the screw by a set screw; a pointer screwed to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bridge, its tip over the dial rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the screws run in the threaded holes of the top bridges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each block slides its full travel; one turn of a bending

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screw moves its roll 1.5 mm; the lock nut holds the setting.
